from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0027:
# Let find the corner line where north wall meets east wall:
arr27 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0027.png"))
# The corner is around x=250.
# The baseboard / floor-wall line to the left of the sofa (north wall) and to the right of the sofa (east wall):
# Let check y of floor-wall meeting point around x=100 (north wall):
for y in range(300, 360):
    if (arr27[y, 100] == [255, 255, 255]).all() and not (arr27[y+1, 100] == [255, 255, 255]).all():
        print("North wall base at x=100: y =", y+1)
        D_nw = 256 * 1.55 / (y+1 - 255.5)
        # ray in map:
        alpha = (100 - 255.5)/256
        pt = np.array([0.866, 2.732]) + D_nw * np.array([np.sin(np.radians(30)), np.cos(np.radians(30))]) + (alpha * D_nw) * np.array([np.cos(np.radians(30)), -np.sin(np.radians(30))])
        print("North wall point:", pt)
'
